Listing 127 - Launching the XSS Attack through curl

Before running our attack, let's start burst and leave in inspect.

We constructed curl to send a special-crafted HTTP request with a User-Agent header containing our payload, then we used Burp to inspect it.

After running the curl command, we can inspect the request in Burp.
